items.item_text: Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in accounting or a related field and/or equivalent experience/training.

Helps implement and/or maintain the general accounting systems. Understands the Oracle financial system general ledger and modules. Understands the accounting behind the transactions flowing through the financial system. Reviews and assists with analysis/evaluation of new chart string values and appropriate accounting for transactions. Provides training and guidance to campus units on transaction processing, reconciliation, and reporting for assigned areas.

Prepares journal entries and maintains and/or reconciles ledger accounts. Prepares journal entries for general accounting activities in the assigned area. Prepares general ledger and supporting ledger reconciliations monthly as assigned. Gathers and analyzes specific dates in ledger accounts and funds utilizing reports available and/or prepares moderately complex reports by querying available databases.

Provides record of assets, liabilities, and other financial transactions. Review fund balances, account/fund group summaries, and various standard and ad-hoc reports for prudent fund management. Work with departmental personnel to resolve overdrafts, unallowable expenses, inappropriate recording of activity, and other fund management-related responsibilities for assigned areas. Develop and provide reports for upper management.

Balances books periodically and prepares financial statements. Prepare ledgers for fiscal year-end closing by reviewing and analyzing balances for reporting. Prepare any fiscal year-end transactions required to close the books for assigned areas. Complete appendices, schedules, and reports on financial data as assigned.

Interprets reports and records for administrators and managers. Reviews and provides complex policy interpretation and compliance review for GAAP, GASB, FASB, and other appropriated fund accounting principles and pronouncements to campus users. Escalates significant issues to supervisor/manager. Maintains current knowledge of fund accounting and legal pronouncements.

Provides analysis for complex accounting projects. Gathers data from the general ledger and applicable guidelines and procedures to analyze complex issues. Provides guidance to departments for processing accounting transactions. Analyze and answer questions from departments and coordinate resolution of issues involving other departments or functions.
Thorough knowledge of accounting function and assignments.
Ability to independently gather, organize, and perform accounting-related analysis to complete work assignments.
Proven ability to effectively present information verbally and in writing.
Thorough knowledge of financial transactions and systems, as well as related policy, accounting, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Thorough knowledge of common desktop / web applications.
Thorough knowledge of analytical procedures used in accounting projects of moderate to semi-complex scope.
